newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers dip, rest of Europe stable.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers dip, rest of Europe stable.

text.p: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers dipped $1 a tonne on Monday as barges came off, while prices in the rest of Europe were stable, dealers said.
Rotterdam bunkers were quoted at around $84 fob, as barges lost $1 to $81/$82 ex wharf.
Total ARA bunker demand barely reached 10,000 tonnes, according to most estimates.
Hamburg fuel oil prices were steady. A reasonable number of enquiries appeared early, but few trades were concluded.
Mediterranean fuel oil was also unchanged while gas oil bunkers rose by $2 a tonne.
As in Hamburg, some suppliers saw a healthy level of enquiries in the morning, but little in the afternoon.
Product was available in all Egyptian ports.
